differences.what: Pale backdrop gives the dark frame edges and tinted horn rim a clean silhouette; in A the blue-grey sweep sits close in value and hue to the blue product, so the cabinet's outline and the horn's left edge sink into the ground
Horn reads as a lighter, more legible translucent blue with a clear gradient toward the throat; in A the horn face goes murky teal and the black driver mass dominates more
Woofer disc and inner panels are a touch brighter with more tonal range (lum p95 117 vs 104), so the internal structure reads better through the clear panels
A's moodier deep-blue set has a more editorial, premium feel and no stray light; B shows a faint horizontal streak off the right side of the cabinet
Floor contact: A's darker floor grounds the base with a visible shadow; in B the soft shadow on the near-white floor is weaker and the cabinet floats slightly
